outputs.name: antelopeDappAdapter
outputs.description: The `antelopeDappAdapter` object is the `antelope-dapp` audit adapter (label 'Antelope and Harbor dApps'); it declares the `dapp` profile, no file extensions, and the optional tools `antelope-cli` and `cdt-cpp`. Its `auditStructure` reads only file and folder paths, never file contents, and reports missing build tooling (no Makefile or CMakeLists.txt) when contract directories exist, missing `.cpp` source or `.hpp` header files per contract directory, and `.clauses.md` or `.contracts.md` files outside a `src/` or `ricardian/` folder; `audit()` always returns no findings.
